notes:
- Prospect: mid-tier asset manager with large research ops (Constellation FRL). Heavy legacy content: research notes, PDFs, models output.
- Primary problem: search quality & speed across 120M+ docs; retrieval noise from scanned PDFs; want embeddings + reranking pipeline to surface best answers for analysts.
- "Urgency: Q2 proof-of-concept, procurement target Apr 2026". Cost-sensitive but will pay for measurable SLA.
- Preferred architecture discussed: vector store for ANN (approx top-100), then cross-encoder reranker on GPU for top-10 re-score. Reranker must run in dedicated pool to meet latency SLOs.
- Data residency: EU-West only; customer-managed KMS (HSM) required for all encryption-at-rest keys. Audit logs and retention controls mandatory (7+ years for certain datasets).
- Token economics note: target cost per query (search + rerank) < $0.02 for baseline queries; willing to accept higher for exception queries with paid routing.
- Quote from Marc D: "We can't have inconsistent answers across regions — residency + traceability are non-negotiable."
- SE notes: will need to benchmark embedding storage footprint (~2TB) and reranker GPU latency with long context (avg 1.8k tokens). Quantization and caching suggestions likely reduce cost.
- Follow-ups: share dedicated pool SLOs, network egress estimates, sample SOW for 2-week POC.
use_case_summary: Primary: enterprise RAG for research portal. Ingest pipelines (HTML, scanned PDFs via OCR, legacy DB exports). Use embedding index for candidate retrieval and run GPU cross-encoder reranker for final ranking. Analysts expect sub-200ms p95 for search+rerank on typical queries and sub-50ms for pure embedding-only fuzzy lookups. Must support bulk re-indexing cadence (monthly delta) and nearline updates for daily research notes.
requirements_summary:
- Index scale: ~120M documents, embeddings store ~1.8-2.2TB (1536-d dim assumed).
- Throughput: 50-200 QPS during business hours; spike handling to 400 QPS for earnings.
- Latency targets: p95 end-to-end search+rerank < 150-200ms; pure ANN retrieval <50ms.
- Cost target: <$0.02/query baseline (negotiable for premium reranking).
- Deployment: Dedicated GPU pool in EU-West, VPC with private connectivity, customer-managed KMS (HSM) + audit logging, SOC2/ISO27001 compliance artifacts required.
- Integrations: SSO (SAML), SIEM forwarding for audit logs, sampling traces to their tracing system, support for long context caching (KV cache) and prefix caching.
- POC: 2-week test: ingest 5-10M representative docs, run load test for target QPS, validate p95 SLA and cost per query metrics.
